result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly. The main visual defect is a loading spinner stuck in the middle of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, indicating the image or content failed to finish loading.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image in the 'Popular right now' section, even though the image behind it appears loaded. This suggests a stuck or orphaned loading indicator.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading spinner is removed once the image/content finishes loading, and add a timeout/fallback state so spinners never persist indefinitely.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card thumbnail has a plain light-gray background, inconsistent with the richer, darker photographic backgrounds of the neighboring restaurant cards, which may look like a missing or placeholder image.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment (full-bleed photo or a defined placeholder style) across all restaurant thumbnails.
